# Zyncat UI - LLM usage guide

Premium React 19 design system, shipped as built ESM + types. This is a compact per-component
index; full prop types (with docs) live in node_modules/@zyncat/ui/dist/*.d.ts.

Setup:
  import { Button } from '@zyncat/ui/button';   // one subpath per component - there is no barrel entry
  import '@zyncat/ui/styles.css';               // base layer (fonts+tokens) - link ONCE; each component lazy-loads its own CSS
Peers: react, react-dom. (The curated Phosphor glyphs used internally are bundled in - not a peer.)
Animation is built in - a ~3 kB WAAPI engine, no animation library to install.
No bundler/transpile config - built ESM keeps 'use client' intact for the Next.js App Router.

Conventions:
- Sentence case everywhere; no emoji or exclamation marks in UI. One primary <Button> per view.
- Numbers, times, IDs, status read mono + tabular. Status words: Scheduled, Draft, Published, Failed.
- Status hues (info/success/warning/danger) only for genuine status; hierarchy from the neutral ramp.
- Icons: Zyncat UI renders its own glyphs from a bundled curated Phosphor set, but does NOT
  export an Icon component. Where an example below shows <Icon name="..." />, that is YOUR OWN icon
  node - any ReactNode you pass into the prop (e.g. an @phosphor-icons/react element).

Every named export is also a subpath: @zyncat/ui/<kebab-name> (e.g. @zyncat/ui/status-badge).

Agents: prefer the bundled MCP server over scanning this file or node_modules - register
  { "mcpServers": { "zyncat-ui": { "command": "node", "args": ["./node_modules/@zyncat/ui/dist/mcp.js"] } } }
  then use list_components / get_component / search_api / get_tokens.

============================================================ PRIMITIVES

Button - @zyncat/ui/button
  One control for every click; exactly one primary per view. variant primary|secondary|ghost|danger|link, size sm|md|lg|icon, loading, disabled. Icons are plain children - Button lays them out in a centered row with gap, no iconLeft/iconRight slots.
  <Button variant="primary"><Icon name="plus" size="sm" />Schedule post</Button>
  <Button size="icon" aria-label="Close"><Icon name="x" size="sm" /></Button>
  +2 more props - get_component('button')

Collapse - @zyncat/ui/collapse
  Layout-transition primitive; eases height open/closed, never teleports. Closed content also
  leaves the tab order, accessibility tree and hit-testing once the exit completes; reopening is
  focusable immediately. animation takes motion tokens ONLY - { duration, ease }, each one token
  (fast|base|slow|slower|slowest / standard|entrance|exit|spring|glide) or per-direction { open, close }.
  <Collapse open={open} animation={{ duration: { close: 'fast' }, ease: { close: 'exit' } }}><div>...revealed content...</div></Collapse>
  +5 more props - get_component('collapse')

Glide / GlidePill - @zyncat/ui/glide
  A persistent background pill that glides smoothly between hovered/active elements. Container must be `position: relative`.
  const glide = useGlide(containerRef);   // { ref, enter, leave } - pass the whole thing to GlidePill
  <nav ref={containerRef} onPointerLeave={glide.leave}>
    <GlidePill glide={glide} className="my-pill" />
    <button onPointerEnter={(e) => glide.enter(e.currentTarget)}>Item 1</button>
  </nav>

Badge - @zyncat/ui/badge
  Glass or outline chip. tone neutral|info|success|warning|danger, dot, live, variant="outline", pill, size="sm".
  <Badge tone="success" pill>Published</Badge>
  +2 more props - get_component('badge')

StatusBadge - @zyncat/ui/status-badge
  Canonical post status - tone + one-word label. status draft|scheduled|processing|published|failed; add `morph` to animate in place as status changes.
  <StatusBadge status="published" />
  <StatusBadge status={s} morph />
  +7 more props - get_component('status-badge')

CountBadge - @zyncat/ui/count-badge
  Mono tabular count; `roll` animates digits like an odometer. value: number | string.
  <CountBadge value="7 / 10" />
  <CountBadge value={count} roll tone="info" />
  +7 more props - get_component('count-badge')

============================================================ FORMS
(all take label, helper/error/warning/success, size sm|md|lg, disabled)

TextField - @zyncat/ui/text-field
  Base text input; states disclose via Collapse. leadingIcon, clearable, optional/required.
  <TextField id="ws" label="Workspace name" required value={v} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value)} />
  <TextField id="h" label="Username" error="Must be at least 4 characters." value={v} onChange={...} />
  +1 more prop - get_component('text-field')

NumberField - @zyncat/ui/number-field
  Tabular figures, caret steppers, unit suffix, clamp to [min,max]. onChange(value: number).
  <NumberField id="seats" label="Seats" unit="users" min={1} max={50} value={n} onChange={setN} />
  +3 more props - get_component('number-field')

OtpField - @zyncat/ui/otp-field
  Segmented one-time code; auto-advance, paste-to-fill. length, group, error, size.
  <OtpField length={6} group={3} value={code} onChange={setCode} />
  +1 more prop - get_component('otp-field')

Textarea - @zyncat/ui/textarea
  Auto-grow, char meter (max), ⌘/Ctrl+↵ submit (onSubmit). minRows/maxRows.
  <Textarea id="bio" label="Bio" max={280} minRows={4} value={v} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value)} onSubmit={save} />
  +5 more props - get_component('textarea')

Checkbox - @zyncat/ui/checkbox
  Stages a choice. label, description, indeterminate, invalid, required, disabled. Standard checked/onChange.
  <Checkbox label="Email me about product updates" checked={on} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.checked)} />
  +2 more props - get_component('checkbox')

Toggle - @zyncat/ui/toggle
  Actuates a setting on the spot. label, description; checked/onChange like a checkbox.
  <Toggle label="Auto-save drafts" checked={on} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.checked)} />
  +2 more props - get_component('toggle')

RadioGroup - @zyncat/ui/radio-group
  Pick exactly one. options: RadioOption[] ({ value, label, description?, icon?, disabled? }); variant rows|cards, orientation; value/onChange(value).
  <RadioGroup name="role" label="Member role" value={role} onChange={setRole} options={ROLES} />
  +3 more props - get_component('radio-group')

Select - @zyncat/ui/select
  Single-select listbox. options: SelectOption[]; value: string|null, onChange(value); searchable, leadingIcon, placeholder, invalid, loading, ariaLabel.
  <Select options={TIMEZONES} value={tz} onChange={setTz} searchable placeholder="Choose a time zone" ariaLabel="Time zone" />
  +6 more props - get_component('select')

MultiSelect - @zyncat/ui/multi-select
  Many-of listbox; stays open while toggling, trigger summarises as first +N. value: string[], onChange(string[]); searchable.
  <MultiSelect options={PEOPLE} value={ids} onChange={setIds} placeholder="Choose members" ariaLabel="Members" />
  +7 more props - get_component('multi-select')

============================================================ DATA DISPLAY

Avatar - @zyncat/ui/avatar
  Identity mark: image, initials, or silhouette. name, src, size xs|sm|md|lg|xl, status online|away|busy|offline, shape, paletteIndex, icon.
  <Avatar name="Ana Ng" src="..." status="online" />
  +1 more prop - get_component('avatar')

AvatarGroup - @zyncat/ui/avatar-group
  Overlapping avatars with +N overflow. max, size; children are <Avatar>s.
  <AvatarGroup max={4} size="sm"><Avatar name="Ana Ng" />...</AvatarGroup>
  +1 more prop - get_component('avatar-group')

Tag / TagGroup - @zyncat/ui/tag
  User-owned label (a control, not a status). icon, size, disabled, onRemove + removeLabel (removable). TagGroup wraps a labelled set.
  <Tag icon={<Icon name="hash" />} onRemove={fn} removeLabel="Remove design">design</Tag>
  +3 more props - get_component('tag')

ToggleTag - @zyncat/ui/toggle-tag
  Many-of-many filter chip. selected/onChange(next) or defaultSelected; icon, count.
  <ToggleTag selected={on} onChange={setOn} icon={<Icon name="star" />} count={48}>Starred</ToggleTag>
  +3 more props - get_component('toggle-tag')

Table - @zyncat/ui/table
  Declare columns + rows; owns sort, selection, stickiness, overflow. columns: TableColumn<T>[] ({ key, label, render?, sortable?, sortBy?, align?, mono?, strong?, grow? }); selectable, defaultSort, footer.
  <Table<Invoice> ariaLabel="Invoices" columns={COLUMNS} rows={INVOICES} selectable defaultSort={{ key: 'amount', dir: 'desc' }} />
  +8 more props - get_component('table')

Pagination - @zyncat/ui/pagination
  Cursor strip: mono range readout + prev/next pair. range: [from,to], total?, hasPrev/hasNext, onPrev/onNext, ariaLabel.
  <Pagination ariaLabel="Rows" range={[from, to]} total={312} hasPrev hasNext onPrev={...} onNext={...} />
  +2 more props - get_component('pagination')

============================================================ DATE, TIME & TABS
(value is a string; onChange(value | null); timezone, min/max, disabled)

DateField - @zyncat/ui/date-field
  Month calendar in a popover; value 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
  <DateField label="Start date" value={d} onChange={setD} timezone="Europe/Riga" min="2026-06-01" />
  +7 more props - get_component('date-field')

DateTimeField - @zyncat/ui/datetime-field
  Calendar + segmented HH:MM; value 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm'. format 12h|24h, minuteStep.
  <DateTimeField label="Due at" value={v} onChange={setV} format="12h" minuteStep={15} />
  +7 more props - get_component('datetime-field')

DateRangeField - @zyncat/ui/date-range-field
  Two-tap auto-ordering window; value DateRange { start, end } | null; commits when both ends exist.
  <DateRangeField label="Reporting period" value={r} onChange={setR} />
  +7 more props - get_component('date-range-field')

TimeField - @zyncat/ui/time-field
  Standalone segmented time; value 'HH:mm'; bounds saturate. format, minuteStep.
  <TimeField label="Send at" value={t} onChange={setT} format="12h" minuteStep={15} />
  +6 more props - get_component('time-field')

Tabs / TabPanel - @zyncat/ui/tabs
  Line tabs; the ink reaches then releases; panels enter from the side you moved toward. items: TabItem[]; value/onChange(value, dir). Pair with <TabPanel name tab dir>.
  <Tabs name="views" ariaLabel="Workspace views" value={view} onChange={(v, d) => { setView(v); setDir(d); }} items={items} />
  <TabPanel name="views" tab={view} dir={dir}>...</TabPanel>
  +2 more props - get_component('tabs')

============================================================ OVERLAYS & FEEDBACK

Alert - @zyncat/ui/alert
  Persistent, in-flow status. tone, title, children (body), action { label, onClick }, dismissible, banner, open/onDismiss (controlled).
  <Alert tone="warning" title="Your trial ends in 5 days" action={{ label: 'Upgrade', onClick: fn }}>Add a plan...</Alert>
  +3 more props - get_component('alert')

Toast - @zyncat/ui/toast  (imperative; mount <Toaster /> once at the app root, then call toast() from anywhere)
  <Toaster /> props: position ('bottom-right' default), duration, visibleToasts, gap, offset, expand. Without it, toast() no-ops.
  toast(msg) - toast.success/error/warning/info(msg, { description, action }) - toast.promise(p, { loading, success, error }) - toast.loading - toast.dismiss().
  import { Toaster, toast } from '@zyncat/ui/toast';
  // once at the root: <Toaster position="bottom-right" />
  toast.success('Changes saved', { description: 'Synced to the cloud' });
  toast.promise(save(), { loading: 'Saving...', success: (v) => `Saved - ${v.count}`, error: (e) => `Failed - ${e.message}` });
  +1 more prop - get_component('toast')

Tooltip - @zyncat/ui/tooltip
  Transient hint on hover/focus; wraps any child (no ref wiring needed). content, shortcut, placement top|bottom|left|right.
  <Tooltip content="Save changes" shortcut="⌘S"><Button>Save</Button></Tooltip>
  +4 more props - get_component('tooltip')

Dialog - @zyncat/ui/dialog
  DEFAULT CHOICE for modals - the styled surface: header (icon/title/description/close), scrolling body,
  footer actions, on top of scrim + focus trap + scroll lock. Reach for Modal only if this chrome is wrong.
  open/onOpenChange, tone, icon, title, description, footer: (close) => node. Header is omitted entirely
  when there is no icon/title/description and dismissible={false}.
  container mounts it inside a positioned element instead of the viewport; scrim, scroll lock and
  inert then scope to that box and the rest of the page stays live.
  <Dialog open={o} onOpenChange={setO} tone="danger" title="Delete this project?" footer={(close) => <>...</>}>...</Dialog>
  +5 more props - get_component('dialog')

Modal - @zyncat/ui/modal
  The SAME modality as Dialog (scrim, focus trap, scroll lock, inert, Esc, motion) with ZERO paint - no
  header, no body padding, no width cap, no border/radius/shadow. You supply the whole surface AND its
  semantics (role="dialog" + a label).
  Use it ONLY when Dialog's chrome is the problem: lightbox / image viewer, full-bleed media, video,
  a custom layout that owns its own edges. If the content is a title + text + buttons, use Dialog instead.
  htmlProps paints the panel (centered by default; width+height 100% = full-bleed), layerProps reaches the
  box behind it (set --bg-overlay to retint the scrim). Also takes trigger, dismissible, container, animation.
  <Modal open={!!src} onOpenChange={() => setSrc(null)} htmlProps={{ className: 'lightbox' }} layerProps={{ style: { '--bg-overlay': 'rgb(0 0 0 / 0.92)' } }}>
    <div role="dialog" aria-label="Image viewer"><img src={src} alt="" /></div>
  </Modal>
  +1 more prop - get_component('modal')

Popover - @zyncat/ui/popover
  Headless anchored panel, non-modal. side, align, arrow, trigger (node), dismissible.
  Anchor without a trigger: pass anchor - anything with getBoundingClientRect (a DOMRect source, an
  element) - and drive open yourself. Pass a new object to re-place a moving anchor.
  <Popover side="bottom" align="start" trigger={<Button>Actions</Button>}><menu>...</menu></Popover>
  <Popover open={!!spot} onOpenChange={dismiss} anchor={spot} side="right"><menu>...</menu></Popover>
  +3 more props - get_component('popover')

Dropdown - @zyncat/ui/dropdown
  Menu button - a list of ACTIONS the trigger commits, with submenus. NOT a Select: it runs a
  command instead of holding a value, so there is no selected state and no form value.
  items takes DropdownItem[] or DropdownGroup[] (labelled sections); a row with its own items
  opens a submenu, nesting as deep as you like. Keyboard is the APG menu button: arrows move,
  Right/Left open and close a submenu, Enter/Space commit, typeahead, Esc one level, Tab the lot.
  <Dropdown trigger={<Button variant="secondary">Actions</Button>} onSelect={(id) => run(id)} items={[
    { id: 'rename', label: 'Rename', shortcut: 'R' },
    { id: 'move', label: 'Move to', items: [{ id: 'drafts', label: 'Drafts' }] },
    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', danger: true }]} />
  <Dropdown open={o} onOpenChange={setO} side="top" align="end" ariaLabel="Row actions" trigger={<Button>...</Button>} items={groups} />
  +3 more props - get_component('dropdown')

Sheet - @zyncat/ui/sheet
  Edge-docked modal panel, drag-to-dismiss. side right|bottom, trigger (node), dismissible.
  container docks it inside a positioned element instead of the viewport; scrim, scroll lock and
  inert then scope to that box and the rest of the page stays live.
  <Sheet side="right" trigger={<Button>Filters</Button>}><div role="dialog">...</div></Sheet>
  <Sheet side="bottom" container={panel} open={o} onOpenChange={setO}><div role="dialog">...</div></Sheet>
  +3 more props - get_component('sheet')

EmojiPickerPanel - @zyncat/ui/emoji-picker
  Searchable emoji panel - grid, scrollspy category rail, recents in localStorage - living in a
  Popover, becoming a bottom Sheet on narrow viewports. Matching is word-based, not fuzzy.
  The dataset is NOT bundled: call loadEmojiData(url | EmojiData) once before the panel first opens
  or it throws; onEmojiDataLoaded(cb) fires when it lands. getEmojiUrl is REQUIRED.
  Two shapes. search renders the panel's own field, opened from trigger. query drives the grid from
  an input YOU own - point popoverProps.anchor at the caret rect and forward keys through the ref.
  import { EmojiPickerPanel, loadEmojiData, getEmojiUrl } from '@zyncat/ui/emoji-picker';
  loadEmojiData('/emojis.json');   // once, before the panel first opens
  <EmojiPickerPanel open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} onSelect={addReaction} getEmojiUrl={getEmojiUrl}
    search trigger={<Button variant="secondary">Add reaction</Button>} />
  +3 more props - get_component('emoji-picker')

============================================================ EXPRESSIVE

Odometer - @zyncat/ui/odometer
  Rolling number display. Each digit column carries its own spring, so digits arrive out of
  sync and blur in proportion to their velocity; a travelling digit tints toward the accent.
  Expressive tier - retune it through --odometer-* on the root: cell, digit, gap, ink, accent,
  separator-ink, size, weight. Pick it over CountBadge roll for display-size figures.
  value is the number; format renders it to a string, where digits become rolling columns and
  everything else becomes a static separator. speed is sampled live every frame.
  Reduced motion snaps to the value without rolling.
  <Odometer value={12480} format={(v) => v.toLocaleString('en-US')} speed={1.2} />
  +1 more prop - get_component('odometer')

TypingLines - @zyncat/ui/typing-lines
  A single line that types itself, holds, deletes, then moves to the next one and repeats.
  lines is the sequence. unit character|word decides whether a character or a whole word
  arrives at a time. caret line|block|underscore|none holds solid while text lands and blinks
  only once the line is idle - pick none for word reveals, where nothing is pending.
  speed is sampled live every frame. Retune through --typing-lines-* on the root: ink,
  caret-ink, size, weight, leading, blink, caret-gap.
  The full line is exposed to screen readers; the animated text is aria-hidden.
  Reduced motion shows the first line complete and never types.
  <TypingLines lines={['Design every state.', 'Make every motion interruptible.']} caret="block" />
  +1 more prop - get_component('typing-lines')

Lens - @zyncat/ui/lens
  An optical loupe that magnifies whatever you wrap. It renders a second live copy of the
  children, scaled about the pointer and clipped to a disc, so magnified text is re-rasterised
  vector type rather than an upscaled bitmap. A MutationObserver re-clones, so edits stay live.
  magnification 1.2-6, radius 60-260 px, chromatic toggles the speed-reactive rim fringing.
  The glass tracks the pointer with no lag; speed drives the specular sweep and the shadow.
  Arrow keys move the glass when the stage has focus, Escape dismisses it.
  Your children stay in the accessibility tree - only the magnified copy is aria-hidden.
  Retune through --lens-* on the stage: ink, surface, edge, highlight, fringe-warm, fringe-cool.
  <Lens magnification={2.6} radius={132}><TypeSpecimen /></Lens>
  +1 more prop - get_component('lens')

============================================================ DEV TOOLS

MotionDevtools - @zyncat/ui/motion-devtools
  Dev-only floating panel that slows or freezes EVERY animation at once (CSS and WAAPI)
  for motion debugging. Mount once at the app root - no provider, touches no other component.
  Gate behind a dev check; keep it out of production.
  placement top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right, offset, presets, maxFactor, defaultFactor,
  scaleTimers, persist, defaultOpen. Also exports motionSlowmo for console/hotkey control.
  {import.meta.env.DEV && <MotionDevtools placement="bottom-right" />}

============================================================ THEMING
  Re-skin by overriding the CSS custom properties (tokens) in your own stylesheet, loaded after
  @zyncat/ui/styles.css - never fork the source. Token groups: spacing --space-*, type --type-*,
  color (--bg-*, --text-*, --border-*, --accent), --radius-*, elevation --shadow-*, motion
  (--duration-*, --ease-*).
